purpose: Operational pilot cases for collection of public campaign websites. Election records do not filter the FEC population.
selection: Ten candidates per office and party. Include these sourced cases, a missing-URL case per group when available, then a deterministic cross-section of existing URL leads.

operational_observations.note: Direct HTTP probe confirms a live redirect. The collector must save content and check identity.
A failed live homepage does not establish missing archives or absence of other campaign URLs.
